cues.en: In the last lecture.
cues.zh: 上一堂課，

cues.en: We stopped at this point after defining the role Choices schema.
cues.zh: 定義完 RoleChoicesSchema 後，停在這裡。

cues.en: Now we're going to define a base user schema, which is going to have all the shared fields of the user model.
cues.zh: 現在定義基礎使用者 schema，包含使用者模型的所有共用欄位。

cues.en: So you can see here class let's just bring this to the top.
cues.zh: 建立 class，先把畫面移到上面。

cues.en: We're going to say base user schema.
cues.zh: 名稱是 BaseUserSchema。

cues.en: This is going to subclass the SQL model.
cues.zh: 繼承 SQLModel。

cues.en: Within the base user schema.
cues.zh: 在 BaseUserSchema 中，

cues.en: We're going to define the fields that are going to be shared by all users.
cues.zh: 定義所有使用者共用的欄位。

cues.en: The first being the username.
cues.zh: 第一個是 username。

cues.en: The username is going to be of type string or none.
cues.zh: username 的型別是 str 或 None。

cues.en: So for the username we're saying a string or none because we're going to be creating usernames automatically for the users.
cues.zh: 允許 str 或 None，是因為會自動替使用者產生使用者名稱。

cues.en: So after that we can say is equals to field.
cues.zh: 接著設為 Field。

cues.en: So this field is a class from SQL model that allows us to define the extra properties for the field.
cues.zh: Field 是 SQLModel 的類別，用來定義欄位的額外屬性。

cues.en: In our case, the extra properties we want to define for the username is the default value, and the default is going to be none.
cues.zh: username 要指定的額外屬性，首先是 default，值為 None。

cues.en: Then the maximum length for the username is going to be 12 characters.
cues.zh: 使用者名稱最長十二個字元。

cues.en: Then unique.
cues.zh: 接著 unique，

cues.en: We're going to set that to true meaning that this field should be unique.
cues.zh: 設為 True，表示這個欄位必須唯一。

cues.en: Then we're going to create an email field.
cues.zh: 再建立 email 欄位。

cues.en: This is going to be of type email string from Pydantic.
cues.zh: 型別是 Pydantic 的 EmailStr。

cues.en: And we're going to set that to a field, then the extra properties for the email field is going to be unique and set to true.
cues.zh: 設為 Field，額外屬性 unique=True。

cues.en: Then index is set to true.
cues.zh: index 也設為 True。

cues.en: So we are setting index to true so that this field can be indexed.
cues.zh: 這樣會為這個欄位建立索引。

cues.en: And remember indexed fields are used to speed up queries.
cues.zh: 記得，索引欄位能加快查詢。

cues.en: Then the maximum length that's going to be 255.
cues.zh: max_length 則設為 255。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the first name.
cues.zh: 接著是 first_name。

cues.en: This is going to be of type string.
cues.zh: 型別為 str。

cues.en: And it's required.
cues.zh: 而且是必填，

cues.en: That's why we don't have none.
cues.zh: 所以不允許 None。

cues.en: And we can say field with the maximum length that's going to be 30.
cues.zh: Field 的 max_length 設為 30。

cues.en: Then middle name of type string a middle name can be optional.
cues.zh: middle_name 可以選填，

cues.en: So we can say string or none.
cues.zh: 所以型別是 str 或 None。

cues.en: Then field with the maximum length being 30 and the default value is none.
cues.zh: Field 的 max_length 是 30，default 是 None。

cues.en: Then the last name.
cues.zh: 接著是 last_name。

cues.en: This is absolutely required.
cues.zh: 這個一定要填。

cues.en: So it's of type A string with a field with the maximum length of 30 characters.
cues.zh: 型別為 str，Field 的 max_length 是 30。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the id number.
cues.zh: 再來是身分證明號碼，

cues.en: So ID underscore number.
cues.zh: 欄位叫 id_number。

cues.en: This is going to be of type integer field with unique id set to true.
cues.zh: 型別是 int，Field 的 unique 設為 True。

cues.en: And the id number should not be negative.
cues.zh: 號碼不能是負數，

cues.en: So we're going to say it should be greater than or equal to zero like that.
cues.zh: 所以設定大於等於 0。

cues.en: Then is active.
cues.zh: 接著 is_active，

cues.en: That's going to be of type boolean and the default value is false.
cues.zh: 型別是 bool，預設 False。

cues.en: So for this particular field we're not adding any extra properties.
cues.zh: 這個欄位不加額外屬性，

cues.en: So we can just set is active to the default value which is false.
cues.zh: 所以直接將 is_active 預設設為 False。

cues.en: Then we can say is super user is going to be of type boolean with a default value of false.
cues.zh: is_superuser 的型別是 bool，預設也為 False。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the security question.
cues.zh: 接著是 security_question。

cues.en: It's going to be of type the security question schema.
cues.zh: 型別是 SecurityQuestionsSchema。

cues.en: And we're going to specify the field with some extra properties.
cues.zh: 使用 Field 指定額外屬性。

cues.en: And the extra property for this is going to be maximum length that is 30.
cues.zh: 這裡的 max_length 是 30。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the security answer that's going to be of type string.
cues.zh: security_answer 的型別是 str。

cues.en: Then we can say field with the maximum length that's going to be 30.
cues.zh: Field 的 max_length 也是 30。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the account status.
cues.zh: 接著是 account_status。

cues.en: As you can see account underscore status that's going to be of type the account status schema that we defined up above.
cues.zh: account_status 使用上面定義的 AccountStatusSchema 型別。

cues.en: Then we're going to specify some extra attributes of this field by saying the default value for this is going to be from the account status schema.
cues.zh: 再透過 Field 指定額外屬性，預設值從 AccountStatusSchema 取得，

cues.en: We can say inactive like that.
cues.zh: 使用 INACTIVE。

cues.en: So the default settings for every account is inactive.
cues.zh: 所以每個帳戶預設都是未啟用。

cues.en: Then for the user role that's going to be of type they're all role.
cues.zh: 接著是使用者角色，型別是 Role，

cues.en: Tracy.
cues.zh: 接上 Choices，

cues.en: Schema.
cues.zh: 再接 Schema。

cues.en: We have defined this up above.
cues.zh: 我們已在上面定義過。

cues.en: Then again, to set the default value in a field by saying field that's going to be default.
cues.zh: 接著用 Field 設定預設值，

cues.en: And that is role choice schema dot.
cues.zh: 使用 RoleChoicesSchema，

cues.en: By default every user is a customer like that.
cues.zh: 預設每位使用者都是 CUSTOMER。

cues.en: Then after declaring the base user schema we're going to create a user create schema that is going to inherit from these base user schema and add the password field.
cues.zh: BaseUserSchema 之後，建立 UserCreateSchema，繼承 BaseUserSchema，並加入密碼欄位。

cues.en: And we're doing this because this particular schema is going to be used to create a new user with a password.
cues.zh: 因為這個 schema 用來建立帶有密碼的新使用者。

cues.en: So you can have another class here call this user create schema is going to subclass the base user schema.
cues.zh: 建立 UserCreateSchema 類別，繼承 BaseUserSchema。

cues.en: Then now we can pass in the password.
cues.zh: 接著加入 password。

cues.en: This is going to be of type string.
cues.zh: 型別是 str。

cues.en: So remember we're doing this because the base user schema should hold the fields that are common.
cues.zh: 記得，BaseUserSchema 應該只放共用欄位。

cues.en: As you can see the base is schema doesn't have the password field.
cues.zh: 基礎 schema 沒有 password。

cues.en: So for the user create schema we're now going to add in the password field of type string.
cues.zh: 所以在 UserCreateSchema 才加入 str 型別的 password。

cues.en: Then we're going to add some extra properties using field.
cues.zh: 再用 Field 加入額外屬性。

cues.en: That's going to be the minimum length which should be eight and the maximum length should be 40.
cues.zh: 最短八個字元，最長四十個字元。

cues.en: Then I can duplicate that.
cues.zh: 複製這一行。

cues.en: The next field is going to be for the confirm underscore password field of type string.
cues.zh: 下一個是 confirm_password，型別是 str。

cues.en: Minimum length is eight.
cues.zh: 最短八個字元，

cues.en: Maximum length is 40.
cues.zh: 最長四十個字元。

cues.en: Then we're going to add some validation for the password matching.
cues.zh: 接著驗證兩次密碼是否相同。

cues.en: We're going to do that by using the field validator decorator.
cues.zh: 使用 field_validator 裝飾器。

cues.en: We had imported it up above.
cues.zh: 上面已匯入。

cues.en: As you can see add a field underscore validator like that.
cues.zh: 寫 @field_validator。

cues.en: And remember this field validator decorator is from Pydantic.
cues.zh: 記得，這個裝飾器來自 Pydantic，

cues.en: And it allows us to validate data before it is saved to the database.
cues.zh: 能在資料存入資料庫前進行驗證。

cues.en: In our case we want to validate the confirm password field to ensure it matches the password field.
cues.zh: 我們要驗證 confirm_password，確保與 password 相同。

cues.en: So how do you do that.
cues.zh: 該怎麼做？

cues.en: So within this field validator in quotation marks we're going to pass in confirm underscore password like that.
cues.zh: 在 field_validator 的引號中傳入 'confirm_password'。

cues.en: Then we can define a function called validate underscore confirm underscore password is going to take in cls v and values.
cues.zh: 再定義 validate_confirm_password，參數是 cls、v 與 values。

cues.en: So remember as we've seen before CLS is a reference to the class itself then.
cues.zh: 記得，cls 參照類別本身。

cues.en: Now this V is going to be the value of the confirm password field.
cues.zh: v 則是 confirm_password 的值。

cues.en: And values is going to be a dictionary of the values of all the other fields in the class.
cues.zh: 講者將 values 說明為類別其他欄位值的字典。

cues.en: So you can say if password is in values dot data and v is not equals to values that data.
cues.zh: 若 'password' 在 values.data 裡，而且 v 不等於 values.data，

cues.en: Get the password like that from the Values Data dictionary.
cues.zh: 從中取得的 password，

cues.en: Get the key of password like that.
cues.zh: 也就是取 password 這個鍵，

cues.en: Then we're going to raise an HTTP exception.
cues.zh: 就拋出 HTTPException。

cues.en: And we're going to have the status code.
cues.zh: 接著指定 status_code。

cues.en: The status code is going to be status dot http underscore 400 bad request.
cues.zh: 值是 status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST。

cues.en: Then we can have another dictionary with some details as you can see.
cues.zh: 再用字典提供詳細資訊，

cues.en: Detail like that we're going to have a key of status with the value of error.
cues.zh: 也就是 detail，先有 status 這個鍵，值為 'error'。

cues.en: Where am I getting this detail.
cues.zh: detail 從哪裡來？

cues.en: This detail is part of a parameter to this HTTP exception from fast API, and it allows you to pass in other details to the exception.
cues.zh: detail 是 FastAPI HTTPException 的參數，可以傳入其他例外詳細資訊。

cues.en: So in our case, we want to pass in the detail of status which is error.
cues.zh: 這裡要傳入 status，值是 error。

cues.en: Then a message.
cues.zh: 再加 message。

cues.en: The message is going to be passwords do not match.
cues.zh: 訊息是「兩次密碼不相同」。

cues.en: And then the action that should be taken is please ensure that the password you entered, much like that.
cues.zh: 接著 action，建議動作是「請確認輸入的密碼相同」。

cues.en: Then remember we're still within the validate confirm password function.
cues.zh: 記得，我們還在 validate_confirm_password 函式裡。

cues.en: We're just going to return v.
cues.zh: 最後傳回 v。

cues.en: And remember v is the value of the confirm password field like that.
cues.zh: 記得，v 是 confirm_password 的值。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And that's it for the user schema.
cues.zh: 使用者 schema 就完成了。

cues.en: In the next lecture we're now going to be working on the user model.
cues.zh: 下一堂課處理使用者模型。
